## Verdict

Kelp costs least for a team of 12, at $96 per month. Its 5-seat minimum sits below the team size, so all 12 seats bill at the $8 list rate with nothing wasted. Acme Desk and Fennel HQ both force payment for seats the team will not use — 13 unused at Acme Desk, 38 at Fennel HQ.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Acme Desk | $14 | 25 |
| Fennel HQ | $19 | 50 |
| Kelp | $8 | 5 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the team size (12) or the vendor minimum, whichever is larger.

- **Kelp:** minimum 5 is below 12, so 12 seats paid. 12 × $8 = **$96 per month**.
- **Acme Desk:** minimum 25 exceeds 12, so 25 seats paid. 25 × $14 = **$350 per month**.
- **Fennel HQ:** minimum 50 exceeds 12, so 50 seats paid. 50 × $19 = **$950 per month**.

Kelp is $254 per month cheaper than Acme Desk and $854 cheaper than Fennel HQ — $3,048 and $10,248 over twelve months. Effective cost per actual person: Kelp $8.00, Acme Desk $29.17, Fennel HQ $79.17.

## Risks

Minimums drive this result, so the ranking is sensitive to headcount. Acme Desk's $350 is fixed until 25 people, at which point its effective rate falls to $14 against Kelp's $200 for the same 25 seats — Kelp still leads on list price at every size here. Fennel HQ does not reach its $19 rate until 50 seats and is not price-competitive in this range.

This is a price comparison only. The list gives per-seat rates and minimums and nothing else: no feature coverage, support tier, usage cap or security detail. A cheaper seat may buy a smaller product, and nothing above tests that.

All figures assume monthly billing as stated. Annual terms, volume discounts, onboarding fees and migration costs are absent from the list and could reorder these totals. Worth confirming whether each minimum binds at signup or only at renewal.
